verdict.rationale: Paperspace's offerings are persistent VMs/Machines (with an auto-shutdown timer, not true scale-to-zero) and 'Deployments' as containers-as-a-service, but no evidence describes autoscaling serverless GPU workers that scale to zero on demand per request. The auto-shutdown feature only stops a machine after 1 hour–1 week of inactivity, which is not equivalent to serverless request-driven autoscaling.
